activate.sh.content:
export GENERATIVEQC_ENV_ROOT=/opt/generativeqc-reuse
export PATH="$GENERATIVEQC_ENV_ROOT/venv/bin:$GENERATIVEQC_ENV_ROOT/cuda-12.9/bin:$PATH"
export CUDA_HOME="$GENERATIVEQC_ENV_ROOT/cuda-12.9"
export CUDACXX="$CUDA_HOME/bin/nvcc"
export CC=/usr/bin/gcc-12
export CXX=/usr/bin/g++-12
export CUDAHOSTCXX=/usr/bin/g++-12
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$CUDA_HOME/lib64${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH}"
